Chapter 15

VolumesVolume

When container images are instantiated as containers, the container needs context—context to CPU, memory, and I/O resources. Pods provide the network and the filesystem context for the containers within. The network is provided as the Pod’s virtual IP address, and the filesystem is mounted to the hosting node’s filesystem. Applications running in the container can interact with the filesystem as part of the Pod context. A container’s temporary filesystem is isolated from any other container or Pod and is not persisted beyond a Pod restart.

当容器镜像被实例化为容器时，容器需要上下文——CPU、内存和 I/O 资源的上下文。Pod 为其中的容器提供网络和文件系统上下文。网络以 Pod 的虚拟 IP 地址形式提供，文件系统则挂载到宿主机节点的文件系统上。运行在容器中的应用可以作为 Pod 上下文的一部分与文件系统交互。容器的临时文件系统与其他任何容器或 Pod 相互隔离，并且在 Pod 重启后不会持久保留。

Essentially, a volume is a directory that’s shareable between multiple containers of a Pod. Figure 15-1 illustrates the differences between the temporary filesystem of a container and the use of a volume.

本质上，volume 是一个可以在同一个 Pod 的多个容器之间共享的目录。图 15-1 展示了容器临时文件系统与使用 volume 之间的区别。

In this chapter, you will learn about the different volume types and the process for defining and mounting a volume in a container.

在本章中，你将学习不同的 volume 类型，以及在容器中定义和挂载 volume 的过程。

— PDF p.219 —
Coverage of Curriculum Objectives考试大纲覆盖

The curriculum doesn’t explicitly mention coverage of volume basics. However, you will definitely need to understand this concept for persistent volumes described in the next chapter.

考试大纲没有明确提到 volume 基础概念的覆盖。但是，要理解下一章介绍的 PersistentVolume，你必须先掌握这个概念。

Purpose of VolumesVolume 的用途

In a nutshell, the Kubernetes volume concept aims to fulfill the goals described here:

简而言之，Kubernetes volume 概念旨在实现以下目标：

  • Data persistence: Applications running in a container can use the temporary filesystem to read and write files. In the case of a container crash or a cluster/node restart, the kubelet will restart the container. Any data that had been written to the temporary filesystem is lost and cannot be retrieved anymore. The container effectively starts with a clean slate again. Volumes can provide persistent storage that survives container restarts, ensuring important data isn’t lost.数据持久化：运行在容器中的应用可以使用临时文件系统读写文件。如果容器崩溃或集群/节点重启，kubelet 会重启容器。任何写入临时文件系统的数据都会丢失且无法找回，容器实际上又重新开始。volume 可以提供在容器重启后仍然存在的持久存储，确保重要数据不丢失。
  • Data sharing: There are many use cases for wanting to mount a volume in a container. One of the most prominent use cases is multi-container Pods that use a volume to exchange data between a main application container and a sidecar, enabling them to share files and communicate through the filesystem.数据共享：在容器中挂载 volume 有很多用途。最典型的用例之一是多容器 Pod，使用 volume 在主应用容器和 sidecar 之间交换数据，使它们能够共享文件并通过文件系统通信。
  • Decoupling storage from containers: Volumes abstract storage details from the application, allowing you to change storage backends without modifying container images.将存储与容器解耦：volume 把存储细节从应用中抽象出来，让你无需修改容器镜像即可更换存储后端。

Volume TypesVolume 类型

Every volume needs to define a type. The type determines the medium that backs the volume and its runtime behavior. The Kubernetes documentation offers a long list of volume types. Some of the types—for example, azureDisk, awsElasticBlockStore, or gcePersistentDisk—are available only when running the Kubernetes cluster in a specific cloud provider. Many of those cloud-provider-specific volume types have already been deprecated.

每个 volume 都需要定义一个类型。类型决定了支撑该 volume 的介质及其运行时行为。Kubernetes 文档列出了很长的 volume 类型清单。其中一些类型——例如 azureDisk、awsElasticBlockStore 或 gcePersistentDisk——只有在特定云厂商上运行 Kubernetes 集群时才可用。这些与云厂商相关的 volume 类型很多已经被弃用。

Table 15-1 shows a reduced list of volume types that I deem to be most relevant to the exam.

表 15-1 列出了我认为与考试最相关的精简版 volume 类型清单。

— PDF p.220 —
TypeDescription
emptyDirEmpty directory in Pod with read/write access. Persisted for only the lifespan of a Pod. A good choice for cache implementations or data exchange between containers within the same Pod.
emptyDirPod 中的空目录，具备读写权限。仅在 Pod 生命周期内持久存在。适合用作缓存实现，或在同一 Pod 内容器之间交换数据。
hostPathFile or directory from the host node’s filesystem.
hostPath来自宿主机节点文件系统的文件或目录。
configMap, secretProvides a way to inject configuration data. For practical examples, see Chapter 10.
configMap、secret提供一种注入配置数据的方式。实用示例见第 10 章。
nfsAn existing Network File System (NFS) share. Preserves data after Pod restart.
nfs一个已存在的 Network File System（NFS）共享。Pod 重启后数据仍保留。
persistentVolumeClaimClaims a persistent volume. For more information, see “Creating PersistentVolumeClaims” on page 210.
persistentVolumeClaim声明一个 PersistentVolume。更多信息见第 210 页“Creating PersistentVolumeClaims”。

Creating and Accessing Volumes创建与访问 Volume

Defining a volume for a Pod requires two steps. First, you need to declare the volume itself using the attribute spec.volumes[]. As part of the definition, you provide the name and the type. Just declaring the volume won’t be sufficient, though. Second, the volume also needs to be mounted to a path of the consuming container via spec.containers[].volumeMounts[]. The mapping between the volume and the volume mount occurs by the matching name.

为 Pod 定义 volume 需要两步。第一步，使用 spec.volumes[] 属性声明 volume 本身，在定义中提供名称和类型。但仅仅声明 volume 还不够。第二步，还需要通过 spec.containers[].volumeMounts[] 把该 volume 挂载到使用它的容器内的某个路径。volume 与 volumeMount 之间通过名称匹配来映射。

From the YAML manifest stored in the file pod-with-volume.yaml and shown in Example 15-1, you can see the definition of a volume with type emptyDir. The volume has been mounted to the path /usr/share/nginx/html inside of the container named nginx and to the path /data inside of the container named sidecar.

从文件 pod-with-volume.yaml 保存的 YAML 清单（例 15-1）中，你可以看到一个类型为 emptyDir 的 volume 的定义。该 volume 被挂载到名为 nginx 的容器内的路径 /usr/share/nginx/html，以及名为 sidecar 的容器内的路径 /data。

Example 15-1. A Pod defining and mounting a volume

例 15-1. 一个定义并挂载 volume 的 Pod

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: business-app
spec:
  volumes:
  - name: shared-data
    emptyDir: {}
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx:1.27.1
    volumeMounts:
    - name: shared-data
      mountPath: /usr/share/nginx/html
  - name: sidecar
    image: busybox:1.37.0
    volumeMounts:
    - name: shared-data
      mountPath: /data
— PDF p.221 —
  • Specifies a volume of type emptyDir. The curly braces mean that we don’t want to provide additional configuration, e.g., a size limit.声明一个类型为 emptyDir 的 volume。花括号表示我们不想提供额外配置，例如大小限制。
  • Mounts the volume to containers with different mount paths inside of the container.把该 volume 以不同的容器内挂载路径挂载到多个容器。

Let’s create the Pod from the YAML definition above. The Pod runs two containers:

我们用上面的 YAML 定义创建 Pod。该 Pod 运行两个容器：

$ kubectl apply -f pod-with-volume.yaml
pod/business-app created
$ kubectl get pod business-app
NAME           READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
business-app   2/2     Running   0          43s

The following commands open an interactive shell to the container named nginx after the Pod’s creation and then navigates to the mount path. You can see that the volume type emptyDir initializes the mount path as an empty directory:

下面的命令在 Pod 创建后打开名为 nginx 的容器的交互式 shell，然后导航到挂载路径。你可以看到 emptyDir 类型的 volume 会把挂载路径初始化为一个空目录：

$ kubectl exec business-app -it -c nginx -- /bin/sh
# cd /usr/share/nginx/html
# pwd
/usr/share/nginx/html
# ls
# touch example.html
# ls
example.html

New files and directories can be created as needed without limitations.

可以根据需要无限制地创建新文件和目录。

Read-Only Volume Mounts只读 Volume 挂载

Some data is only meant for consumption, for example, configuration data provided through a volume. You can mark a volume mount to be read-only. Kubernetes will prevent any write operation on that volume mount. It’s important to understand that other containers may use the same volume in read/write mode.

有些数据只用于消费，例如通过 volume 提供的配置数据。你可以把某个 volume 挂载标记为只读。Kubernetes 会阻止对该挂载点的任何写操作。需要注意的是，其他容器仍可以以读写模式使用同一个 volume。

To make a volume mount read-only, assign the value true to the attribute spec.containers[].volumeMounts[].readOnly, as shown in Example 15-2.

要把 volume 挂载设为只读，把 spec.containers[].volumeMounts[].readOnly 属性设为 true，如例 15-2 所示。

Example 15-2. A mount path marked as read-only

例 15-2. 一个被标记为只读的挂载路径

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: business-app
spec:
  volumes:
  - name: shared-data
    emptyDir: {}
— PDF p.222 —
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx:1.27.1
    volumeMounts:
    - name: shared-data
      mountPath: /usr/share/nginx/html
      readOnly: true
  • Prevents write operations for this mount path阻止对该挂载路径的写操作

Read-only mounts are not recursively read-only. You can force the behavior though by setting the attribute .spec.containers[].volumeMounts[].recursiveReadOnly to true. See the Kubernetes blog for more information.

只读挂载并不递归只读。不过你可以通过把 .spec.containers[].volumeMounts[].recursiveReadOnly 属性设为 true 来强制该行为。更多信息见 Kubernetes 博客。

Summary本章小结

Kubernetes provides volumes to decouple storage from the container’s lifecycle, enabling both ephemeral and persistent data storage, as well as data sharing between containers in a Pod.

Kubernetes 提供 volume，把存储与容器的生命周期解耦，既支持临时数据存储，也支持持久数据存储，还支持同一 Pod 内容器之间的数据共享。

Exam Essentials考试要点

Understand the need and use cases for a volume理解 volume 的需求与用例

Many production-ready application stacks running in a cloud native environment need to persist data. Read up on common use cases and explore recipes that describe typical scenarios. You can find some examples in the O’Reilly books Kubernetes Best Practices by Brendan Burns et al. and Cloud Native DevOps with Kubernetes by John Arundel and Justin Domingus.

运行在云原生环境中的许多生产级应用栈都需要持久化数据。请阅读常见用例，并探索描述典型场景的实践方案。你可以在 O’Reilly 出版的两本书中找到一些示例：Brendan Burns 等著的《Kubernetes Best Practices》，以及 John Arundel 和 Justin Domingus 合著的《Cloud Native DevOps with Kubernetes》。

Practice defining and consuming volumes练习定义与使用 volume

Volumes are a cross-cutting concept applied in different areas of the exam. Know where to find the relevant documentation for defining a volume and the multitude of ways to consume a volume from a container. Definitely revisit Chapter 10 for a deep dive on how to mount ConfigMaps and Secrets as a volume.

volume 是一个横切概念，会在考试的不同领域中出现。要知道去哪里查找定义 volume 的相关文档，以及容器使用 volume 的各种方式。务必复习第 10 章，深入了解如何把 ConfigMap 和 Secret 作为 volume 挂载。

  1. Open an interactive shell for Container 1 and create the directory data in the mount path. Navigate to the directory and create the file hello.txt with the contents “Hello World.” Exit out of the container.为容器 1 打开交互式 shell，在挂载路径下创建目录 data。进入该目录，创建内容为“Hello World.”的文件 hello.txt。退出容器。
  2. Open an interactive shell for Container 2 and navigate to the directory /etc/b/data. Inspect the contents of file hello.txt. Exit out of the container.为容器 2 打开交互式 shell，进入目录 /etc/b/data。查看文件 hello.txt 的内容。退出容器。
